entities.summary: The House of Andrássy is the name of a Hungarian noble family of that was prominent in Hungarian history. The full family name is Andrássy de Csíkszentkirály et Krasznahorka. Csíkszentkirály is a town in modern-day Romania, now called Sâncrăieni, while Krásna Hôrka is a castle in Slovakia. Andrássy Palace is a palace from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
